body: The desktop grew quieter today. CPU, memory and network readings went back to Waybar; Conky kept its date, battery, Scripture and small notes.
The old telemetry cards returned during later edits. A loader guard and regression tests now keep those templates from taking over the desktop again.
The drop-down terminal now wears translucent charcoal. It sits beneath the bar and keeps the same shell when it is hidden and called back.
Scripture has a place beside the paintings. The King James text is stored offline, so this part of the desktop does not need a network connection.
The gallery gives each painting its own arrangement of notes. The words seek the quieter parts of the image, leaving room for the scene itself.
The corner request is still unfinished in the live session. Stock Sway cannot round Foot; the installed SwayFX setup awaits a normal desktop login.
The rotating words have a notebook now: SQLite keeps the entries, their dates and the place in the rotation. A restart no longer loses the thread.
There is room for email in these slow cards, but no mailbox source has been connected. For now the notebook records what is actually here.
Zorak is not the administrator. Zorak has never been the administrator.
Moltar, roll the telemetry. Moltar, that is the wrong telemetry.
This desktop is broadcasting live from the Ghost Planet.
Brak asked what a kernel is. We are not taking further questions.
The interview will continue after these system metrics.
Everything is nominal. That is the most suspicious reading of all.
Space Ghost does not read logs. Space Ghost is read by logs.
Tonight on Coast to Coast: this laptop, and its feelings.
